title: They Tried to Corner Silver. It Cost Them Billions #shorts
description:
In 1980, two Texas billionaire brothers tried to corner the world silver market. Silver hit nearly fifty dollars, then crashed in two months on Silver Thursday.
Follow for more stories of money that vanished overnight.
first_comment: Greedy gamble or genius move that just came one rule too late? 👇

lines.text: Two Texas billionaires tried to buy all the silver in the world.
The Hunt brothers were worth billions from oil.
But in the nineteen seventies, they feared that the dollar would collapse.
So they bought silver. Tons of it. And kept buying.
In a year, the price went from six dollars to nearly fifty.
Then the exchange changed the rules, and it banned new purchases.
The price started falling. The brothers owed millions in margin calls.
On March twenty-seventh, nineteen eighty, silver crashed under eleven dollars.
The brothers lost more than a billion dollars in two months.
Years later, they were banned from commodities markets, and one filed for bankruptcy.
